DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 配送のSMSが来ました。注文した荷物はありますが、この番号は注文履歴と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文中の荷物はあるがSMSと注文履歴の番号が違うと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a delivery text message. I am expecting an order, but this number is different from the one in my order history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are expecting a parcel, but the numbers in the text message and order history differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: SMSのリンクを開いたり、再配達の情報を入力したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you opened the text message's link or entered any redelivery information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開いていません。注文中だから本物だろうと思って、今から入力するところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リンク未操作だが注文があるため本物と思って入力しかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not opened it. Since I have an order, I thought it was probably genuine and was just about to enter the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not used the link but assumed it was genuine because you have an order and nearly entered information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文があることだけで同じ荷物とは確認できません。履歴の番号を示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Having an order alone does not confirm that it is the same parcel. Can you show the number in your order history?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 履歴を見せます。SMSの末尾は八七、注文の方は三二です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 履歴を提示しSMSと注文の番号末尾の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show you the history. The text message number ends in 87, while the order number ends in 32.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the history and explain in Japanese the different last digits of the numbers in the text message and order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの番号が違う点を記録します。確認は注文先の正式な窓口から行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will note that the two numbers differ. Please check through the official contact for the place you ordered from.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 注文履歴の問い合わせ機能を使います。SMSの番号は転記しない方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文履歴から正式問い合わせを行いSMS番号の伝え方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the inquiry function in my order history. Should I avoid copying the number from the text message?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will make an official inquiry through the order history and ask how to communicate the text message's number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 問い合わせには両方を区別して示すと伝わります。リンク操作や支払いは確認前に進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can make it clear by showing both numbers separately in the inquiry. Please do not use the link or proceed with payment before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 注文の番号とSMSの番号を分けて問い合わせます。SMS画面と受信時刻も保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両番号を区別して照会しSMS画面と受信時刻を保存すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will inquire with the order number and text message number clearly separated. I will also save the text message screen and the time it arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish both numbers in your inquiry and save the text message screen and receipt time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。返答があっても疑問が残る場合はまたご相談ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If you still have questions after receiving a reply, please consult us again. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。発送でご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Do you have a question about shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 皿を重ねてこの箱に入れました。丈夫な箱なら割れずに届きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重ねた皿を丈夫な箱で送れば破損しないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I stacked plates in this box. Will they arrive unbroken if the box is sturdy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether stacked plates will arrive without damage if sent in a sturdy box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱だけで破損しないとは保証できません。皿同士の間には何を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The box alone cannot guarantee that they will not break. What did you put between the plates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何も入れず五枚を重ねました。周りに新聞を詰めただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 皿五枚の間に緩衝材を入れず周囲だけ新聞を詰めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I stacked five plates with nothing between them. I only packed newspaper around them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you stacked five plates without cushioning between them and put newspaper only around them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中で皿同士が当たる状態ですね。個別に緩衝材で包むなど、梱包を見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the plates can hit one another inside. Please reconsider the packaging, such as wrapping each plate in cushioning separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いったん持ち帰って一枚ずつ包みます。大きい箱へ替えた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち帰って一枚ずつ包み直し外箱の大きさも変えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take them home and wrap each plate separately. Should I change to a bigger box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will take them home to rewrap individually, and ask whether the outer box should also be a different size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な余裕は梱包後の大きさで変わります。空間が大きくても中が動くなら見直しが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The space needed depends on the size after wrapping. Even with a lot of space, you need to reconsider the packaging if the contents can move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 包んだ皿が動かないようにします。送り状の品名は食器だけでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 皿の動きを防ぐと伝え送り状の品名をどう書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will make sure the wrapped plates cannot move. Is it enough to write tableware as the contents on the shipping label?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will prevent the plates from moving, and ask how to write the contents on the shipping label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 皿五枚と具体的に書いていただけます。割れ物であることも受付でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can write five plates specifically. Please also tell us at acceptance that they are fragile.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚ずつ包み直し、箱内の動きを確認してから持ってきます。品名は皿五枚と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個別梱包と箱内の動きを確認して皿五枚と記載し改めて発送すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rewrap them individually and check for movement inside the box before bringing it back. I will write five plates as the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check individual packaging and movement inside the box, label the contents as five plates, and bring them back to send.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今回は箱をお返しします。梱包後に改めてご相談ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will return the box to you this time. Please consult us again after packing it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 記帳で通帳を預けましたが、預り札がありません。今呼ばれた番号が自分か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳預り札をなくし呼出番号が本人のものか不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I handed over my passbook to have it updated, but I do not have the claim ticket. I do not know whether the number just called was mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you lost the passbook update claim ticket and do not know whether the number called belongs to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号だけで受け取らず、預けた窓口と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not collect it based only on the number. Tell me which counter you left it at and when.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十五分前に一番窓口で預けました。番号は七が付いていた気がするだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預けた窓口と時刻を示し番号記憶は曖昧と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I left it at counter one fifteen minutes ago. I only vaguely remember a seven being in the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the counter and time you left it, and that your memory of the number is uncertain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 曖昧な番号を本人のものと決めず、担当が記録を確認します。本人確認の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than assuming an uncertain number is yours, the person in charge will check the record. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。呼ばれた通帳には触らず、こちらで確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認資料を持参しているが呼出通帳を取らず照会を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not touch the passbook that has been called and will wait here for the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have identification but will not take the passbook called and will wait for the inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人を確認して預り状況を調べます。通帳の表紙の色だけでは判定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will verify your identity and check the deposit record. We will not decide based only on the passbook cover's color.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の通帳は青ですが、青い物はほかにもあります。名前を大声で読み上げないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表紙色だけでは区別できず氏名の大声読上げを避けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My passbook is blue, but there are other blue ones too. Please do not read my name aloud loudly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the cover color alone cannot distinguish it and ask that your name not be read out loudly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 個別に確認します。札が見つかった場合も、記録と照合してから返却をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check privately. Even if the ticket is found, we will explain the return procedure only after comparing it with the record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料を担当へ示します。札の番号を推測せず、自分の預り記録の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人資料で預り記録を照会し札番号を推測しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show my identification to the person in charge. Please check my passbook deposit record without guessing the claim ticket number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will use identification to check the passbook deposit record and will not guess the ticket number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。通帳の返却までこちらでお待ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the person in charge. Please wait here until your passbook is returned. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。会計の操作でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble operating the checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面にお釣りとありますが、まだお金を入れていません。そこへ金額を入力するのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未投入のセルフレジでお釣り欄に金額を入力するのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen says change, but I have not put any money in yet. Am I supposed to enter an amount there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether to enter an amount in the change field at a self-checkout where you have not inserted money yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お釣りは支払後の表示欄です。今の合計は千二百円で、投入額はゼロです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Change is a display field for after payment. Your current total is twelve hundred yen, and the inserted amount is zero.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。財布には硬貨が少ししかなく、千二百円には足りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 所持硬貨では表示された千二百円に足りないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I only have a few coins in my wallet, and they are not enough for twelve hundred yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the coins you have are not enough for the displayed twelve hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お金はまだ入れていないので、ほかの支払い方を確認しましょう。カードをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Since you have not inserted money yet, let us check other payment methods. Do you have a card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードはあります。この現金の画面からカードへ変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 所持カードへ現金画面から支払方法を変更できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I do. Can I change from this cash screen to card payment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can change the payment method from the cash screen to the card you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この端末は現金専用です。会計をこちらで戻し、カード対応のレジへ案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This terminal only accepts cash. I will reverse the transaction here and take you to a checkout that accepts cards.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。商品をもう一度全部読む必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別レジへ案内を頼み商品の再登録が必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Will all the products have to be scanned again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to be directed to another checkout and check whether the products need to be entered again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでは記録を移せないので、別のレジで登録し直します。この会計は取消しを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We cannot transfer the record here, so we will enter them again at another checkout. I will confirm this transaction has been canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未払いの会計を取り消してから、商品を持ってカードのレジへ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現会計の取消し確認後に商品を持ってカード対応レジへ移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: After the unpaid transaction has been canceled, I will take the products and move to the card checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will take the products to a card-accepting checkout after confirming cancellation of the current transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 取消しを確認しました。こちらのレジへどうぞ。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed the cancellation. Please come to this checkout. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。落とし物のお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you asking about lost property?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手袋を一組なくしました。片方だけでも届いていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: なくした一組の手袋が片方でも届いていないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost a pair of gloves. Has even one of them been handed in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether even one glove from the pair you lost has been handed in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 茶色の片手袋があります。お客様の手袋の模様を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have one brown glove. Please tell me the pattern on your gloves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左右とも手首に白い線があります。右だけ内側に名前を書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左右共通の白い線と右だけの内側の名前を特徴として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both have a white line at the wrist. I wrote my name inside only the right one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the white line on both wrists and the name inside only the right glove.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届いた物は線がなく、名前もありません。こちらを受け取られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The one handed in has no line or name. Would you like to collect this one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 違う物なので受け取りません。私の左右は同じ模様です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届出品は特徴が違うため受け取らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, it is different, so I will not take it. My left and right gloves have the same pattern.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not take the handed-in item because its features are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では一組として特徴を記録します。最後に外したのはどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we will record the features as a pair. Where did you last take them off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 売店前で携帯を使った時です。左右をコートのポケットに入れたつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売店前で携帯を使うため外しコートのポケットへ入れたつもりだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: In front of the shop when I used my phone. I thought I had put both in my coat pockets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you took them off in front of the shop to use your phone and thought you put them in your coat pockets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まずご自身のポケットも確認してみてください。園内で見つかれば登録した連絡先へ知らせられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your own pockets first too. If they are found in the park, we can notify you at your registered contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここでポケットを確認しましたがありません。売店前も見て、一組の届け出をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ポケットにないことを確認して売店前も探し一組の届出を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked my pockets here, but they are not there. I will look in front of the shop too. Please file a report for the pair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you checked they are not in your pockets, will look in front of the shop too, and request a report for the pair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 特徴と場所を記録します。届いた際の連絡先をご確認ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record the features and location. Please confirm your contact details for when they are handed in. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車について何を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about the trains?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遅延証明をもらいたいです。書いてある時間だけ職場へ遅れると言えばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延証明の時間をそのまま自分の出勤遅れとして伝えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a delay certificate. Can I tell my workplace I will be late by exactly the time written on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can report the delay certificate's time directly as your own lateness for work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証明は路線の遅延状況で、お客様の到着時刻そのものではありません。どこまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The certificate records the line's delay, not your own arrival time. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 終点から会社まで歩きます。証明が二十分なら、出勤も二十分遅れだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 終点から徒歩移動があり証明の二十分を自分の遅刻時間と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I walk from the terminal station to my company. I thought if the certificate said twenty minutes, I would also be twenty minutes late for work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you walk from the terminal and thought the certificate's twenty minutes was your own lateness.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 駅からの移動もありますね。列車の到着見込みはまだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you also need to travel from the station. The train's expected arrival time has not been confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では職場へ、今は駅で待っていて到着は未定と伝えます。証明はどこで受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場へ駅待機と到着未定を伝え証明の取得先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will tell my workplace I am waiting at the station and do not know when I will arrive yet. Where can I get the certificate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will tell work you are waiting at the station with no confirmed arrival time, and ask where to get the certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では案内カウンターで取得方法を確認できます。現在の表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this situation, you can check how to get it at the information counter. Please look at the current display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示は運転再開を確認中ですね。再開したら職場へ改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運転再開確認中の表示を読み再開後に職場へ追加連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The display says they are checking when service can resume. I will contact work again once it resumes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the display saying service resumption is being checked and explain in Japanese that you will update your workplace after it resumes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。表示が更新されてから乗車を判断してください。証明だけで運転再開を判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please decide whether to board after the display is updated. Do not decide that service has resumed based only on the certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 証明を確認しつつ運行表示を待ちます。再開後に歩く時間も含めて出勤見込みを連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運行表示を確認し徒歩時間を含む見込みを再開後に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the certificate while waiting for the service display. Once service resumes, I will report my expected arrival at work, including the walking time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the service display and report an estimate including walking time after service resumes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。カウンターはこちらです。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The counter is here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日の相談はどのような内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の休憩中です。三つ相談したいのですが、三十分で全部終わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩中の三件の相談を三十分で終えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am on my work break. I have three matters to discuss. Can all of them be finished in thirty minutes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether three matters can all be discussed within thirty minutes during your break.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 待ち時間もあるため終了時刻は約束できません。最優先の内容はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: There may be waiting time, so we cannot promise a finishing time. Which matter has the highest priority?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日締切の書類の確認です。他の二つは来週でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日締切の書類を最優先とし他二件は翌週でよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Checking a document due today. The other two can wait until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the document due that day is the highest priority and the other two matters can wait until the next week.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まずその一件に絞って担当へ伝えます。職場へ戻るため、何時までに退出する必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will focus on that one first and tell the person in charge. What time must you leave to get back to work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十二時四十分です。呼ばれなければ、勝手に帰らず受付へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 退出期限を示し呼ばれない場合も受付へ伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Twelve forty. If my number has not been called, I will tell reception rather than just leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your latest departure time and answer in Japanese that you will tell reception even if your number has not been called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 退出される場合は番号札をこちらへ返し、再相談の予定をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you leave, please return the numbered ticket here and discuss plans for a further consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 締切の書類だけ、別の確認方法があるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 締切書類について来庁以外の確認方法もあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: For the document with the deadline, I would also like to ask whether there is another way to have it checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether there is a way to check the document with the deadline without visiting the office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ確認しますが、電話などで対応できるかは内容によります。今は書類を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check with the person in charge, but whether it can be handled by phone or another means depends on the content. Please show the document now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の書類を見せます。時間内に難しければ担当の確認方法を聞き、残り二件は別日に予約します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 優先書類を示し時間不足なら担当へ確認方法を聞き他二件は別日予約にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show today's document. If there is not enough time, I will ask the person in charge how to check it and book the other two matters for another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will show the priority document, ask the person in charge about checking methods if time is insufficient, and book the other two for another day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 優先内容と退出時刻を伝えます。番号が呼ばれるまでこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell them the priority matter and your departure time. Please wait here until your number is called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。会計についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you have a question about payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この金額を次回の予約票にも書けば、次の支払いに使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日の会計金額を次回予約票に書けば次の支払いに使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: If I also write this amount on my next appointment slip, can I use it for the next payment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether writing today's billed amount on the next appointment slip lets you use it for the next payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書は今回の支払い記録です。次回の費用を示すものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The receipt records this payment. It does not indicate the cost of your next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ診察なら同じ金額と思っていました。今日の明細に分からない項目もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ診察なら同額と思っていたが今日の明細にも不明項目があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the same consultation would cost the same amount. There are also items on today's breakdown that I do not understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the same consultation would cost the same amount, but also do not understand some items on today's breakdown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの行でしょうか。会計の担当が項目をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which line is it? The billing staff will explain the items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この検査と書いてある行です。診察料とは別になっている理由を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 検査項目と診察料が分かれている理由を会計担当へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This line that says test. I would like to know why it is separate from the consultation fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the billing staff in Japanese why the test item is separate from the consultation fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内訳を担当へ確認します。次回の予約票は別にして、持参物の欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the breakdown with the person in charge. Keep the next appointment slip separate and look at its section on what to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次回は今回の資料を持参とあります。領収書だけではなく、診療で渡された紙も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回持参資料は領収書だけか診療で受け取った紙も必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says to bring the documents from this visit next time. Do I need the papers handed to me during treatment as well as the receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the documents to bring next time mean only the receipt or also the papers received during treatment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 何の資料を指すかは診療担当へ確認します。今お持ちの紙を示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask the clinical staff which documents that refers to. Could you show the papers you have now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部の紙を分けて見せます。今日の明細は会計担当へ、次回の持参資料は診療担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙を分類して今日の内訳と次回持参物をそれぞれの担当へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separate and show all the papers. I will ask billing staff about today's breakdown and clinical staff about documents to bring next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will sort the papers and check today's breakdown and next visit's required documents with the respective staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれの担当へおつなぎします。予約票と領収書をお手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will put you in touch with each staff member. Please keep your appointment slip and receipt with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの通学路について相談したいです。私が通る近道を教えても大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大人が使う近道を子どもの通学路として教えてよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like advice about my child's route to school. Is it all right to teach my child the shortcut I use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether it is all right to teach a child an adult's shortcut as a school route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 学校の通学路の案内はありますか。お子さんの経路と大人の経路を分けて見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the school's route guidance? Let us look at your child's route separately from the adult route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学校の地図があります。指定は大通り側ですが、私の近道は倉庫の裏です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学校指定は大通りで本人の近道は倉庫裏と二経路を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the school's map. The designated route is along the main road, but my shortcut goes behind a warehouse.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two routes in Japanese: the school designates the main road, while your shortcut is behind the warehouse.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図の指定と異なりますね。近道の方で気になっている場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it differs from the map's designated route. Is there any place on the shortcut you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 倉庫の車が出る門です。私は通れますが、子どもの目線では車が見えにくそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 倉庫車両の門が子どもの目線で見えにくいと懸念を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The gate where warehouse vehicles come out. I can pass it, but vehicles seem hard to see from a child's eye level.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Express in Japanese your concern that vehicles at the warehouse gate are hard to see from a child's eye level.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その門の位置を地図に示してください。ここで近道の安全を保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please mark that gate on the map. We cannot guarantee the shortcut's safety here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 門はこちらです。学校に指定経路の理由を聞き、自分の近道を先に教えるのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図で門を示し学校への理由確認前に近道を教えることを待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The gate is here. I will ask the school why it designated that route and wait before teaching my own shortcut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the gate on the map and explain in Japanese that you will wait to teach the shortcut until you have asked the school its reasons.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 学校へ相談する際は地図と門の位置を見せてください。変更が認められたとはまだ考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: When consulting the school, please show the map and gate location. Do not assume a route change has been approved yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地図の指定路と倉庫裏を分けました。学校に確認してから子どもと通学の経路を練習します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定路と近道を分け学校確認後に子どもと経路を練習すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have marked the designated route separately from the route behind the warehouse. After checking with the school, I will practice the school route with my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish the designated route from the shortcut and practice the route with your child after checking with the school.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。気になる地点を整理してご相談ください。お帰りも周囲にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please organize the locations you are concerned about when consulting them. Watch your surroundings on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。どのようなご用件ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在票の期限は明日です。今夜仕事が終わってから荷物を取りに来てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保管期限が翌日の荷物を仕事後の夜に窓口で受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The deadline on my missed-delivery notice is tomorrow. May I come to collect the parcel after work tonight?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can collect the parcel at the counter after work at night when its holding period ends the next day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何時ごろになりますか。保管期限と窓口の営業時間は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: About what time would that be? The holding deadline and counter opening hours are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜九時です。明日までなら今夜はいつでも受け取れると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九時到着予定で保管期限内ならいつでも受取可能と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nine at night. I thought I could collect it at any time tonight as long as the deadline was tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you expect to arrive at nine and thought collection was possible at any time within the holding period.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この窓口は夜九時には閉まっています。明日の昼に来るか、配達の相談が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This counter will be closed at nine at night. You will need to come around midday tomorrow or discuss delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昼は来られます。本人が来る時に何を持てばいいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翌日昼なら来局できるため本人受取の持参物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can come around midday. Please tell me what to bring if I collect it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can come around midday the next day, and ask what to bring for personal collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この不在票の持参物欄と荷物の種類を担当が確認します。今の票を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the required-items section on the missed-delivery notice and the parcel type. Please show the notice you have now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 票はこちらです。再配達なら、明日の夜にできるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在票を提示し翌日夜の再配達も利用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the notice. I would also like to ask whether redelivery tomorrow night is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the missed-delivery notice and ask in Japanese whether redelivery the next evening is also available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ両方確認します。希望枠が取れるまでは再配達が決まったとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check both with the person in charge. Do not assume redelivery is arranged until the requested slot is secured.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼の窓口受取を第一候補にします。必要な物を確認し、難しければ夜の再配達を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昼の窓口受取を優先し必要物を確認して難しければ再配達を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: My first choice is collection at the counter around midday. I will check what is needed and, if that is difficult, ask about redelivery at night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will prioritize midday counter collection, check the required items, and discuss redelivery if collection is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 不在票を拝見してご案内します。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will look at the missed-delivery notice and explain. Please wait here.
